title: Slow Cooker Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful North African-inspired stew made with tender lamb and a blend of aromatic spices. Perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Season the lamb with salt, black pepper, and Algerian spice blend.
Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the lamb until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add chopped onion to the pot. Cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
If using, add velvety tomato paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add spicy harissa (if using) and cook for 1 minute.
Add chicken broth, browned lamb, and any accumulated juices to the pot. Bring to a simmer.
Transfer the pot to a slow cooker and cook on low for 8-10 hours or on high for 4-6 hours.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve over couscous or rice.
